note: Computed from NIFTYBEES over 23 sessions. The benchmark is the Nifty 50 ETF (NIFTYBEES), which tracks the index and is present for every session.

cautions.survivorship: This archive contains only stocks listed on NSE TODAY. Companies that were delisted, merged or suspended are absent, so past returns here look better than they really were. Treat every historical figure as an upper bound.
cautions.adjusted: Prices are corporate-action adjusted by the pipeline before this runs.
cautions.min_sample: Any bucket with fewer than 20 observations is hidden rather than published.
